command: import json; from pathlib import Path; from src.application.storage import VaultEpisodeStore; from src.core.mission_authorization import load_mission_authorization; from src.core.contract_validation import validate_against_schema; a=load_mission_authorization('plans/plan_009/m2_real_handoff/mission/mission-authorization.json'); assert a.mission_id=='R2_M2_P2_PLAN009_REAL_TOPIC_BELONGING'; assert a.execution_profile_ids==('codex_current',); assert a.execution_mode=='REAL'; assert 'ANY' not in a.execution_profile_ids+a.allowed_routes; s=VaultEpisodeStore.from_settings(Path('config/local_settings.json')); f=Path(s.resume('ep_0002')['folder']); h=json.loads((f/'01_editorial_intake_handoff.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8')); assert validate_against_schema(h,'editorial_intake_handoff')==[]; print('P2_HANDOFF_PREP_FOCUSED_OK')

objective: Recuperar ep_0002, preparar y ejecutar únicamente el ENRICHMENT canónico mediante agent_handoff, importar y validar TopicBelongingInput y detenerse antes de Producer.
preconditions: Owner selected execution_profile codex_current and model_override gpt-5.6-luna.
reasoning_effort is omitted because codex_current does not declare support.
REAL_COGNITIVE_EXECUTION is limited to the owner-selected ENRICHMENT handoff.
No API or local model execution is authorized.
expected_outputs: Valid human input and editorial intake handoff bound to the supplied topic and question
Valid current MissionAuthorization for codex_current and agent_harness
Fresh completion gate evidence bound to current mission inputs
Imported and contractually valid TopicBelongingInput from the owner-selected ENRICHMENT handoff
Producer handoff remains blocked until separately authorized
deterministic_validations: MissionAuthorization loader and exact scope verification
AgentHandoffProvider package checksum and manifest validation
No ANY and no fallback route
Owner-selected model is transported without unsupported reasoning_effort
AgentHandoffProvider import_result checksum, manifest and output-contract validation
No API, local-model or integrated-executor fallback
adversarial_cases: Missing unresolved enrichment fields treated as a TopicBelongingInput
Handoff preparation bypasses canonical runtime resolution
Fabricated ResolvedExecutionRoute without resolver evidence reaches handoff preparation
stop_conditions: Missing real topic_belonging_input for producer handoff
Owner model or unsupported reasoning is inferred
Any fallback to API, local model, mock or synthetic output
Canonical vault_root is missing or unresolved
P3.1, commit or push requested implicitly
